sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 56087 of 2022
Applicant :- Gulrez Khan

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Devendra Kumar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Mansha Devi,Smt. Mandvee Mishra Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma,J.
None present for the applicant even in revised call.
Learned A.G.A. for the State is present.
Perused the material available on record.

The instant application for bail has been moved on behalf of the applicant- Gulrez Khan with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 140 of 2022, under Sections 363 and 376 of I.P.C.
and 3/4 POCSO Act, and under Section 3/4 Conversion of religion against law, Police Station- Khoda, District- Ghaziabad, during pendency of the trial.
Learned counsel for applicant contends that from the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. It is very much clear that the victim was consented party to the alleged occurrence/offence.
The accused is in jail since 17.04.2022.
Hence the bail application to be allowed.
Contrary to that learned A.G.A. contends that there is no value of consent of a minor girl in the eye of law.

Further, it is contended by learned A.G.A that the victim was knowing the accused as 'Aryan' Hindu by caste and when she knew that the applicant was 'Gulrez Khan' Muslim by caste she refused to Gulrez Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14522139/
1 continue the relation any more but even after her denial she was taken away forcefully and was confined for five months by the applicant-accused where the accused used to commit rape with her every day.

entities.text: Gulrez Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The accused also denied the marriage tied with her.
It has further contended that from the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. it is very much clear that not only sexual assault was committed by the accused but she was also beaten by the accused.
In this case the accused has also been charge sheeted under Section 3/4 of Conversion of Religion against Law.

Thus, having regard to the aforesaid facts and circumstances and also keeping in view the arguments advanced on behalf of the parties, nature and manner of commission of offence and evidence regarding the complicity of applicant, no case for bail, at this stage, is made out.
Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
